seiyuuNetwork.title: Seiyuu Relation Map
seiyuuNetwork.intro: Start from one voice actress and pick who shared a work with her, who belongs to her agency, or who is in the same franchise. Every correct pick adds a node to your map.
seiyuuNetwork.rule1: Each round gives you four candidates, and only one is really connected to her.
seiyuuNetwork.rule2: A wrong pick costs one heart; the round ends when all {{lives}} hearts are gone.
seiyuuNetwork.rule3: The round also ends when there is nothing left to connect, and then you can render a portrait map of your network.
